title: Question: why is the General panel always open and unclosable?
author: SmearODeer

comments.author: Er4twXz
comments.snippet:
if one adds a panel it is automatically also named "General". If one renames those panels they can be deleted.

My goal would be to hide the panels header row. But i could not find a way.

comments.author: SmearODeer
comments.snippet:
Thanks @Er4twXz, that's the cause. I checked the code: a panel counts as "the General panel" only because of its title. `ConnectionWindow.IsGeneralPanel` compares `TabText` with `PanelAdder.DefaultPanelName` ("General"), and every new panel gets that name by default. So:

- every panel left with the default name is permanent: no close button, and closing is cancelled
- renaming any panel *to* "General" makes it permanent too
- renaming the real one makes it closable

This also affects #3710 (emp...

comments.author: Er4twXz
comments.snippet:
From my perspective:

- if there is only one panel do not show any panel header or panel name
- naming them Panel2, Panel 3 ... could cause trouble because of the keybindings 1 ...10 --- maybe it's better to directly force the user to enter a panel name 
- one panel should always be left - warn user if he tries to delete the last remaining panel

- panels with name should be removable, unique panel names should be enforced
